note: KOA Journey (formerly Bridgeview RV Resort) in the Oldman River valley in Lethbridge, off Hwy 3 at the Bridge Drive exit; treed sites with river-valley paths beside the park, not on the river. Heated pool in summer, store. The 50-amp sites have a 34-35 ft minimum length and one back-in loop has a 21 ft maximum, so a 23-ft rig books from the 30/20-amp types. Water is shut off to all but extended-stay sites in winter (KOA page, 2024-25 season). --Claude
